description: This file defines the WarningReportingUnit class and its nested Setting class, including JSON serialization, cloning, category management, and warning reporting functionalities within the Thunder::WarningReporting namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Main class managing warning reporting categories and events, implementing cloning, category management, and reporting functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents a warning reporting setting with JSON serialization support, including category, enabled status, excluded categories, and configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing Setting objects.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a category control based on category name.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of category names.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches default and current enabled/disabled status, excluded categories, and configuration for a given category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Returns the default categories configuration as a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Sets the default categories configuration from a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier and event information.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnit.
